periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique-vertical; the primary axes of the patches converge toward the muzzle at approximately 60-70 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated vertical oval; length significantly exceeds width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Substantial; the patch tapers towards the bottom with the mass concentrated in the superior two-thirds.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape transition between the black dorsal band and the white lower back fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High; the band spans approximately 35% of the visible torso height from the base of the neck.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation positioned at the superior-lateral corners of the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex curvature at the superior boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-yellow discoloration of the ventral fur compared to the high-contrast white cranial fur.
